mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_code, c.active, c.cover_image, c.start_date, c.end_date FROM edu.courses c INNER JOIN edu.enrollments e ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_code, c.active, c.cover_image, c.start_date, c.end_date FROM edu.courses c INNER JOIN edu.enrollments e ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.courses (id, course_name, description, course_code, active, cover_image, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseName}, #{description}, #{courseCode}, #{active}, #{coverImage}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.courses SET course_name = #{courseName}, description = #{description}, course_code = #{courseCode}, active = #{active}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.enrollments (course_id, user_id, enrolled_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{teacherId}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (course_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO edu.enrollments (course_id, user_id, enrolled_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{studentId}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (course_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
